WHAT TO DO NOW

1. Contact Kisumu Lakeside Hospital on +254 57 202 0000 to confirm the case and get the case details you need.

2. Follow the IDSR technical guidelines for Cholera: case investigation, specimen collection for laboratory confirmation, and control measures.

3. Pass it on to the sub-county or county surveillance coordinator if that isn't you.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

The case is in KHIS under the IDSR immediate-notification programme. If more cases of Cholera are recorded, each one gets its own notification. If several come close together, you may also get a separate outbreak alert.
